provenance.citation: Reiter, R. (1980). A Logic for Default Reasoning. Artificial Intelligence, 13(1-2), 81-132.
provenance.locus: Section 1.1 — the canonical 'birds fly' default bird(x) : M flies(x) / flies(x), with penguins as the exceptional subclass that blocks the default.
provenance.notes: Tweety is a penguin; penguins are birds and do not fly. The flies default's justification M flies(tweety) is inconsistent with not_flies, so the extension contains not_flies and NOT flies, with an explicit block step.
